description: Reject one existing proposal returned by soclo_page_autopilot; only that stored proposal changes. Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_autopilot before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

proposal_id.description: The exact existing proposal id returned by soclo_page_autopilot.

name: soclo_page_autopilot_reject
title: Reject a Website Autopilot proposal
